## Board of Directors - Minutes Q4 2025

Strictly confidential

## 1. Attendance and quorum

Meeting held on 27 January 2026 at Tampere Works, Finland. Present: Maria Peltoniemi, Margareta Lindqvist (Chair), Henrik Aalto, Dr. Ines Carvalho, Pieter van Dam, Valdemar Peltonen. Also in attendance: Ilari Pesonen (COO) and Anne Laakkonen (General Counsel, secretary to the board). Quorum was confirmed.

The minutes of the previous meeting were approved without amendment.

## 2. Financial performance

The CFO reported Q4 FY2025 revenue of EUR 109.8 million against a budget of EUR 111.8 million, with an adjusted EBITDA margin of 13.7% and cash of EUR 37.3 million.

Order intake for the quarter was EUR 126.8 million, giving a book-to-bill ratio of 1.15.

| KPI | Q4 FY2025 | Budget |
|---|---|---|
| Revenue | EUR 109.8m | EUR 111.8m |
| EBITDA margin | 13.7% | 14.5% |
| LTIFR | 0.52 | 0.70 |
| On-time delivery | 93.1% | 93.0% |

## 3. Resolutions

The Board requested a cybersecurity maturity assessment following the identity provider outage.

The Board approved the 2026 long-term incentive plan for the executive team.

The next meeting is scheduled for 28 April 2026.
